circā

circā (+ accusative)

preposition with the accusative; often an adverb

around, round about; near

In this lexicon

  • around

    the recommended word · classical · Liv. 1.4.6: ex montibus quī circā sunt; Plin. Ep. 5.6.23: circā sipunculī plūrēs

Examples

  • fonticulus in hōc, in fonte crātēr; circā sipunculī plūrēs miscent jūcundissimum murmur

    in it a little spring, in the spring a basin; round it several little jets mingle a most pleasant murmurPlin. Ep. 5.6.23
